item.title: Efi Partition Restore
item.description: While cleaning up fonts on the Efi partition to resolve failing bios updates, I realized that the fonts do need to be restored.

item.title: Efi Partition Font Cleanup
item.description: On Windows, the EFI partition is only 100 MB. You may be able to extend it if there is free space between this partition and the next one.

item.title: Managing Debt For Use Of Self
item.description: When the intervener is in survival, the intervener cannot see.

item.title: Power
item.description: Work begins when there is desire to bring change. Power, the access to trust and influence, is needed for change.

item.title: Psychological Safety
item.description: This is closely related to Trust.

item.title: Roles of the Gestalt Intervener
item.description: In clean interventions, we are not agents of change. We are agents of awareness so that there is always choice.

item.title: Systems and Gestalt Theory
item.description: Systems Theory This is a very analytical approach Focuses on patterns, cause/effect, finding out what is missing Historical analysis Looks at what is scarce This is diagnostic work Gestalt Theory Takes an opposite approach to system theory in many ways.

item.title: The Wisdom of Trauma
item.description: Notes from the movie The Wisdom of Trauma (direct video link) Trauma Trauma is typically thought of as terrible things happening to you, but can also occur without horrible things happening to you.

item.title: Trust
item.description: Distinctions live in language. Language is unique to humans. Distinctions create tribes.

item.description: These are the 9 developmental clusters for the use of self identified by Mee Yan Cheung-Judge.
